subject: Encryption & compliance discovery / SOC 2 + BYOK next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marta Silva <marta.silva@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:14:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Horizon Health encryption & SOC 2 discovery

Hi Marta — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can scope the security/infra deep dive: 

Call recap / assumptions
- Horizon is evaluating Redwood for chat/analysis pipelines touching PHI (as discussed) — HIPAA applies.
- Primary concern areas: at-rest encryption, key custody (BYOK/CMEK), in-transit protections, and evidence (SOC 2/HIPAA certs + network diagrams).

Immediate asks (can you share these items?):
1) Latest SOC 2 or equivalent report (Type II preferred).
2) High-level crypto overview: do you require customer-managed keys (BYOK/CMEK) or is Horizon OK with provider-managed CMKs? Any preference for AWS KMS vs CloudHSM or third-party HSM?
3) Key rotation / retention policy and whether key material will be stored/managed in your cloud account or a separate HSM.
4) Does Horizon require a private network (VPC peering / PrivateLink) for traffic to inference endpoints?
5) Security contact for technical deep-dive (name/email) and procurement contact for SOW/contract questions.

Attachments: I can share our security questionnaire (quick spreadsheet) and a short mutual action plan template after you confirm preferred format.

Next steps
- If you can share SOC 2 + a short crypto doc, Ben and Aditya will line up a 60-minute security + infra call next week to walk key flows and confirm SOW language.
- Proposed slots: Wed 12/8 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 12/9 14:00–15:00 PT — let me know what works.

Thanks — look forward to continuing.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0172

[attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)]

From: Marta Silva <marta.silva@horizonhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@horizonhealth.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Horizon Health encryption & SOC 2 discovery

Hi Lauren — great to connect. Per your asks, see answers below and attached artifacts.

Short answers
- SOC 2: attached is our SOC 2 Type II report for 2025 (redacted where needed).
- HIPAA/GDPR: HIPAA applies; Horizon is US-based but we have a small EU patient subset — GDPR clauses will be required in contract.
- Key custody: Horizon requires customer-managed keys. We currently use AWS KMS with customer-managed CMKs (imported key material in a CloudHSM cluster) for most workloads. We can provide access patterns for a dedicated KMS alias in our AWS account or work with a separate HSM solution if required.
- Key rotation: annual rotation by default; emergency rotation procedures documented in the attached crypto overview.
- Network: preferred approach is PrivateLink between Horizon and vendors for production PHI flows; dev/test can use TLS over public endpoints.

Attachments included:
- Horizon_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (SOC 2 Type II)
- Horizon_Crypto_Overview.pdf (1-page architecture + key lifecycle)
- Horizon_Security_Contact.txt (primary security contact info)

Procurement note: procurement@horizonhealth.com is copied here. They asked for a short mutual action plan and SOW language that captures BYOK + private networking + audit evidence delivery cadence.

We can do the technical deep-dive next week. Thurs 12/9 14:00 PT works for our security engineer (will invite).

Thanks,
Marta Silva
Director of IT Security | Horizon Health
marta.silva@horizonhealth.com
[attachment: Horizon_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (document stub)]
[attachment: Horizon_Crypto_Overview.pdf (document stub)]

Good notes — quick internal summary for SOW / commercial lead: 

1) BYOK requirement confirmed (AWS KMS + CloudHSM-backed imported key material). Need to capture in SOW:
   - Clause for customer-owned keys (CMEK) and proof-of-configuration prior to production cutover.
   - Support for PrivateLink or VPC peering; list of required IP ranges and egress rules to be collected by infra.

2) Evidence delivery cadence: request access to SOC2 report (received), and quarterly audit log exports for first 12 months (Horizon prefers audit-to-customer cadence; we need to agree on method — API vs s3 pulls).

3) Commercial / procurement asks: add BYOK operational runbook as an annex, include data residency / GDPR clause, and confirm indemnity language around PHI.

I added the HubSpot opportunity and attached a draft mutual action plan in the CRM: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910 (link to opportunity RDW-5421).

Action items
- Aditya: prep a short runbook template showing how Redwood will integrate with Horizon's KMS alias and private networking (target: 12/7 EOD).
- Lauren: share Redwood questionnaire (sent) and propose final deep-dive slot (confirm with Marta).
- Me: follow up with procurement for SOW redlines and start drafting BYOK annex.

Ben Carter
